data.title: 卡提希娅 · 铁匠铺的保养
data.description: 铁匠铺，她把迅刀交给师傅保养，趴在柜台边看锻打的火花；聊起剑的手感时眼睛发亮——比起圣女，她更习惯骑士的身份。
data.action: 铁匠铺，她把迅刀交给师傅保养，趴在柜台边看锻打的火花
data.promptProse: Cartethyia gives her swift blade to the blacksmith for maintenance, then leans at the counter watching the sparks with bright interest. Her cream high-collared tunic, blue travel jacket and practical trousers keep the knightly identity clear. The medium portrait includes the workbench and smith behind the counter. Forge light warms her blonde braid and hands, glinting along the resting weapon while the shop's farther tools remain darker against the wall.
